newsitem.title: SWEDEN: FORECAST - Trygg-Hansa '96 profit 2.61 bln SKR.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST - Trygg-Hansa '96 profit 2.61 bln SKR.

text.p: Swedish insurer Trygg-Hansa was expected on Thursday to post a pre-tax profit of 2.61 billion crowns for calendar 1996, according to a Reuters poll of seven analysts released earlier.
Forecasts varied between 2.39 and 3.03 billion crowns.
The result for the first nine months was 2.10 billion crowns and the large range in forecasts was due to difficulties in estimating profits in the fourth quarter.
A comparison with 1995 profits was not relevant due to changes in accountancy rules.
The average forecast for Trygg-Hansa's dividend was 3.40 crowns a share.
Analysts interviewed for the poll were from Aros, Enskilda, Fiba, Handelsbanken, Penser, Swedbank and Ohman.
Trygg-Hansa is due to publish its result on February 6. It will hold a press conference at 1300 GMT to discuss its earnings.
